description: Pre-registered decisive benchmark configuration for external rare-failure queries across Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100.
success_criterion: A budget supports the idea only if sparse_internal has RMSE ratio <= 0.80, bootstrap CI high < 1.0, beats strong output/embedding/per-query baselines, beats PCA/random ablations by at least 5%, and amortizes build labels within 20 audited queries.
disproof_criterion: A budget disconfirms this implementation if sparse_internal is >= MC, fails label-matched amortization, is not better than strong baselines, and PCA/random ablations are comparable.
